mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (login_id, pw, name, email, phone) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{pw}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone})

choose.when: SELECT AAA.* FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY created_at DESC) as r, users.* FROM users WHERE login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') ) AAA WHERE AAA.r BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end}
SELECT AAA.* FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY created_at DESC) as r, users.* FROM users WHERE phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') ) AAA WHERE AAA.r BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blacklist WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blacklist (email, reason) VALUES (#{email}, #{reason}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE reason = VALUES(reason)
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET role = #{role} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_titles SET is_equipped = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_titles (user_id, title_id, is_equipped, enhance_level, fail_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{titleId}, 1, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE user_titles SET is_equipped = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND title_id = #{titleId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_titles WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND title_id IN (100, 101)
